title: Nalysnyky
subtitle: Ukrainian savoury crepes filled with herbed cottage cheese
excerpt: Thin Ukrainian crepes wrapped around a salted cottage cheese and dill filling, then pan-fried in butter until golden. A light but filling lunch or dinner that comes together quickly.
sourceNotes: Traditional Ukrainian dish; savoury cheese-filled version common as a weekday lunch.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze filled and rolled before frying. Fry from frozen over a low heat with a lid on.
recipe.batchNotes: Double the batter and filling. Make a large batch of crepes and fill them all at once.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the crepes a day ahead and keep stacked with paper between them. Fill and fry to order.

content.text: Nalysnyky are thin Ukrainian crepes rolled around a savoury cottage cheese and dill filling. They are pan-fried in butter after filling, which crisps the outside. Rest the batter before cooking or the crepes will be too thick.
Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, melted butter and salt into a smooth, thin batter. Rest it for 15 minutes while you prepare the filling.
Mix the drained cottage cheese, beaten egg, dill, salt and pepper together in a bowl. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Heat a crepe pan or small frying pan over a medium-high heat. Brush with a little butter. Pour in just enough batter to coat the base thinly. Swirl to spread.
Cook for about 1 minute until the edges lift and the top looks dry. Flip and cook for 30 seconds more. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with all the batter. You should get about 12 crepes.
Place 2 tablespoons of filling in the centre of each crepe. Fold in the sides, then roll up into a neat parcel.
Heat a knob of butter in the frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the filled crepes in batches, seam-side down, for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve hot with soured cream on the side if you like.

items.cause: The batter was too thick or the pan not hot enough.
items.fix: Thin the batter with a splash of milk and ensure the pan is properly hot before adding batter.

items.symptom: The filling is watery and leaks out.
items.cause: The cottage cheese was not drained well enough.
items.fix: Drain in a sieve for 20 minutes and press out excess moisture before mixing.

items.cause: The crepes were not rolled tightly, or the pan was too hot.
items.fix: Press the seam down in the pan for the first 30 seconds to seal. Use a medium rather than high heat.
